title: Dhani Harrison is born | 1978
content:
Dhani Harrison, the son of George and Olivia Harrison, was born on 1 August 1978.

He was born at HRH Princess Christian’s Hospital in Windsor, Berkshire, and was named after the sixth and seventh notes of the Indian music scale, dha and ni.
